PackagingType.name: Packaging type (UNECE Recommendation 21)
PackagingType.listID: UNECE Recommendation 21 - Codes for Passengers, Types of Cargo, Packages and Packaging Materials (with Complementary Codes for Package Names)

qau: The language of Urvania, invented for the world; a code from the range qaa-qtz that ISO 639-2 reserves for local use.
qal: The language of Lisavu, invented for the world; a code from the range qaa-qtz that ISO 639-2 reserves for local use.

codes.48: Interest charged on an amount paid after its due date, at the statutory or agreed rate.
codes.64: An allowance the parties have agreed in their contract.
codes.95: A general discount on the price.
codes.96: The cost of insuring the goods.
codes.100: A rebate outside the ordinary price terms.

source.version: D.16B with later additions (OpenPeppol peppol-bis-invoice-3 via poacc-upgrade-3, commit c3bd29f)

XB:TaxExemptionReason.name: Sales tax exemption reason
XB:TaxExemptionReason.description: Why a sale carries no state sales tax in Bayvarra; also used by the Northern Territory.

EXP: Goods or services sent to a buyer outside Bayvarra.
WATER: Drinking water supplied through the mains is exempt.
PUBLIC: A body of the federation, a state or a city buys free of sales tax.
SVCB2B: A service supplied to a business is not a retail sale.
RESALE: The buyer resells the goods or uses them in its products and charges the tax on its own retail sale.
LEVY: Levy collected for a public body
An amount the seller collects on behalf of a public body, such as the city's sewage levy.
MEDICAL: Medicine on prescription and medical aids.
CHARITY: A charity registered in Bayvarra buys for its charitable purpose.

XU:TaxExemptionReason.name: Value added tax exemption reason
XU:TaxExemptionReason.description: Why a supply carries no Urvanian value added tax.

EXP: Goods sent to a buyer outside Urvania; the export is evidenced by the customs declaration.
SVCABROAD: Service to a business established outside Urvania
The service is taxed where the customer is established.
HEALTH: Care by a licensed doctor, dentist or hospital.
EDUCATION: Teaching by a recognised school or university.
RENT: The rent of a home, not of business premises.

TaxLevel.name: Tax level
TaxLevel.description: The level of government that levies a tax.

NATIONAL: A tax of the country as a whole, such as Urvania's value added tax.
STATE: Levied by a state or territory
A tax of a state or a federal territory, such as Bayvarra's state sales tax.
LOCAL: Levied by a city or municipality
A local tax or levy, such as a city's sewage levy.
ACCORD: A charge the Trade Accord's member states levy jointly.

TaxType.name: Tax type
TaxType.description: What a tax is levied on.

CONSUMPTION: A tax on goods or services consumed, such as value added tax, sales tax or an excise.
INCOME: A tax on the income or profit of a person or business, including a withholding tax.
PROPERTY: A tax on land, buildings or other assets.
TRADE: Customs duty and other taxes on imports or exports.

SupplyType.name: Supply type
SupplyType.description: Whether a taxed supply is of goods or of services, which the tax rules treat differently.

GOODS: A supply of goods, including energy and water delivered through a network.
WORKS: Construction or installation work on immovable property.

AccountFormat.name: Account number format
AccountFormat.description: The structure of an account number.

ISO13616: Country code, two check digits and the national account number, as ISO 13616 defines for the IBAN. The world's countries are not registered IBAN countries, so the numbers are not called IBANs.
BBAN: The national account number alone, without country code and check digits.
LEDGER: An address on a distributed ledger, without a bank account number.

ISO20022CashAccountType.name: ISO 20022 ExternalCashAccountType1Code
ISO20022CashAccountType.version: as published by the ISO 20022 RA
ISO20022CashAccountType.reference: ISO 20022 external code sets, iso20022.org (blocked for automated access, 403)

CACC: Account used to post debits and credits when no specific account has been nominated.
CARD: Account used for card payments only.
SLRY: Account used for the payment of salaries.

ISO20022ClearingChannel.name: ISO 20022 ClearingChannel2Code
ISO20022ClearingChannel.reference: ISO 20022 data dictionary, ClearingChannel2Code (iso20022.org, blocked for automated access)

RTGS: Clearing channel is a real-time gross settlement system.
RTNS: Clearing channel is a real-time net settlement system.
MPNS: Clearing channel is a mass payment net settlement system.

ISO20022ChargeBearer.name: ISO 20022 ChargeBearerType1Code
ISO20022ChargeBearer.reference: ISO 20022 data dictionary, ChargeBearerType1Code (iso20022.org, blocked for automated access)

DEBT: All transaction charges are to be borne by the debtor.
CRED: All transaction charges are to be borne by the creditor.
SHAR: Transaction charges on the sender side are to be borne by the debtor, on the receiver side by the creditor.
SLEV: Charges are to be applied following the rules agreed in the service level.

ISO20022ServiceLevel.name: ISO 20022 ExternalServiceLevel1Code
ISO20022ServiceLevel.version: as published by the ISO 20022 RA
ISO20022ServiceLevel.reference: ISO 20022 external code sets, iso20022.org (blocked for automated access, 403)

NURG: Payment must be executed as a non-urgent transaction, which is not to be processed by a real-time gross settlement system.
URGP: Payment must be executed as an urgent transaction cleared through a real-time gross settlement system.
SDVA: Payment must be executed with same day value to the creditor.

ISO20022Purpose.name: ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code
ISO20022Purpose.version: as published by the ISO 20022 RA
ISO20022Purpose.reference: ISO 20022 external code sets, iso20022.org (blocked for automated access, 403)

SUPP: Transaction is related to a payment to a supplier.
GDDS: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of goods.
SCVE: Transaction is related to purchase and sale of services.
ELEC: Transaction is related to a payment of electricity bill.
GASB: Transaction is related to a payment of gas bill.
WTER: Transaction is related to a payment of water bill.
PHON: Transaction is related to a payment of telephone bill.
TAXS: Transaction is the payment of taxes.

ISO20022SequenceType.name: ISO 20022 SequenceType3Code
ISO20022SequenceType.reference: ISO 20022 data dictionary, SequenceType3Code (iso20022.org, blocked for automated access)

FRST: First collection of a series of direct debit instructions.
RCUR: Direct debit instruction where the debtor's authorisation is used for regular direct debit transactions initiated by the creditor.
FNAL: Final collection of a series of direct debit instructions.
OOFF: Direct debit instruction where the debtor's authorisation is used to initiate one single direct debit transaction.
RPRE: Collection used to re-present previously reversed or returned direct debit transactions.

DEBIT: Each payment is debited from the holder's account at once.
CREDIT: Payments are collected on a credit line and settled periodically.
PREPAID: Payments are taken from an amount loaded onto the card in advance.

InterestCalculation.name: Interest calculation method
InterestCalculation.description: How interest on an amount is calculated.

SIMPLE: Interest on the principal only, per day, at the yearly rate.
COMPOUND: Interest on the principal and on interest added at the end of each period.

FinancingInstrument.name: Trade financing instrument
FinancingInstrument.description: The instrument by which a trade transaction is financed.

FACTORING: The seller sells its receivables to a factor, who collects them.
INVOICEDISC: A lender advances money against the seller's receivables, which the seller still collects.
SCF: A bank pays the supplier early on the strength of the buyer's approval of the invoice.
DOCCREDIT: The buyer's bank undertakes to pay against the documents named in the credit.
FORFAITING: A forfaiter buys the seller's medium-term receivables without recourse.

FXContractType.name: Foreign exchange contract type
FXContractType.description: The kind of contract by which currency is bought.

SPOT: Currency bought for delivery within two business days.
FORWARD: Currency bought now at a fixed rate for delivery on a later date.
SWAP: A spot purchase combined with a forward sale of the same amount, or the reverse.
OPTION: The right, not the obligation, to buy or sell currency at a fixed rate.

PAYMENT: An amount due has not been paid.
FINAL: The last reminder before the claim goes to collection.
DOCUMENT: A document that was due has not been received.

ACCOUNT: The open items and payments between two parties over a period.
BALANCE: The balance on a date, for the other party to confirm.
COMMISSION: The commission an agent has earned in a period.

APPROVED: The payment is approved and will be made.

PeriodDescription.name: Period description
PeriodDescription.description: What kind of period an invoice period is, following the UBL definition of Period/DescriptionCode (a description of the period).

WEEK: A calendar week, Monday to Sunday.
MONTH: A calendar month, from its first day to its last.
QUARTER: Three calendar months, starting in January, April, July or October.
HALFYEAR: Six calendar months, starting in January or July.
YEAR: A calendar year, from January to December.
SEASON: A season of a crop or a trade, as the contract defines it.

Market.name: Market identifier
Market.description: The regulated markets of the world, coded in the shape of ISO 10383 market identifier codes (four characters). Each code is checked against the ISO 10383 list, so that none is a real MIC.

XFER: The regulated market of Urvania, in Ferrano.
XLMX: The regulated market of Bayvarra, in Lumeport.
XSLN: The island's securities market, in Selanu.

Colour.name: Colour
Colour.description: The colour of an item or of a part of it, as a code.

GRY: Grey, such as Ferro grey (RAL 7011) of the bench frames.

EmissionCalculationMethod.name: Emission calculation method
EmissionCalculationMethod.description: How an emission figure was obtained.

CALCULATED: Calculated from activity data and emission factors.
ESTIMATED: Estimated from comparable products or default values.

ContractType.name: Contract type
ContractType.description: The kind of a contract between a buyer and a supplier.

FRAMEWORK: Sets the terms for orders or releases placed during its term, without committing to quantities.
SINGLE: One supply or service, ordered once.
SUPPLY: Recurring supplies at agreed quantities over the term.
CONCESSION: The supplier is paid by running the service it provides.

RecordStatus.name: Record status
RecordStatus.description: Whether a document, a price list or a record is in force.

ProfileStatus.name: Profile status
ProfileStatus.description: Whether a trade item location profile is in force.

TransportMeansType.name: Transport means type
TransportMeansType.description: The kind of vehicle, vessel, aircraft or installation that carries goods. The descriptions name the nearest code of UNECE Recommendation 28 where its published list has one; the world's own list is used because the codes of Recommendation 28 for barges, trucks with trailers and pipelines could not be checked against a published copy.

BOXTRUCK: A rigid truck with a closed box body.
TRUCKTRAILER: A truck or tractor unit pulling a trailer or container chassis (UNECE Recommendation 28, 3100 series).
CRANETRUCK: A truck with its own crane for loading (UNECE Recommendation 28, 3131 Truck, with crane for lifting goods, without trailer).
FARMTRACTOR: A farm tractor pulling trailers, for goods off the public road network.
FREIGHTTRAIN: A train of freight wagons (UNECE Recommendation 28, 2302 Train, container; 2301 Blocktrain).
DRYBARGE: An inland waterway vessel for dry cargo.
CONTAINERSHIP: A sea-going ship for containers (UNECE Recommendation 28, 1511 Full container ship/cellular vessel).
CARGOAIRCRAFT: An aircraft that carries cargo only (UNECE Recommendation 28, 4000 Aircraft, type unknown).
PIPELINE: A fixed pipeline for gas or liquids.

ShipConfiguration.name: Ship configuration
ShipConfiguration.description: The design of a vessel by the cargo it is built for.

FEEDER: A small container ship serving ports that the large liners do not call at.
DRYBARGE: An inland barge with open holds for dry cargo.
GENERALCARGO: A ship with holds for break-bulk cargo and containers.
BULKCARRIER: A ship for dry bulk such as ore or grain.
TANKER: A ship for liquids in bulk.

TransportService.name: Transport service
TransportService.description: The kind of transport service a carrier offers.

FTL: One truck for one consignment, from the place of loading to the place of delivery.
LTL: A consignment that shares the truck with others.
RAILCONT: Containers on a scheduled container train.
RAILWAGON: A whole wagon for one consignment.
OCEANCONT: Containers on a scheduled liner service by sea.
MERCHHAUL: The carriage of a container to or from the port arranged by the merchant, not the shipping line.
CARRHAUL: The carriage of a container to or from the port arranged by the shipping line.
NOTIFY: The carrier gives notice before it arrives.
WEIGH: The goods or the vehicles are weighed.

TravelDirection.name: Travel direction
TravelDirection.description: The direction of a journey or service, as carriers name their services.

DS: On a river, with the current.
US: On a river, against the current.

TransportEventType.name: Transport event type
TransportEventType.description: What happens to goods or means of transport on their way.

DEPARTURE: The means of transport leaves a place.
ARRIVAL: The means of transport arrives at a place.

TransportExecutionStatus.name: Transport execution status
TransportExecutionStatus.description: Where the carriage of a consignment stands.

PLANNED: The carriage is planned and not yet started.
CANCELLED: The carriage will not take place.

TransportationStatusType.name: Transportation status type
TransportationStatusType.description: What a transportation status reports or asks for.

PROGRESS: The progress of the carriage against the plan.
DELIVERY: Whether and when the goods were delivered.

StatusCondition.name: Status condition
StatusCondition.description: The condition a status reports, of goods, means of transport, a consignment or a document.

RELEASED: Released by customs or another authority.
MATCHED: An invoice agrees with the order and the receipt (three-way match).
MISMATCHED: An invoice does not agree with the order or the receipt.

StatusReason.name: Status reason
StatusReason.description: Why a status is as reported.

CLEARED: Customs or the border authority has cleared the goods.
INSPECTION: An authority holds the goods to inspect them.
CONGESTION: Delayed by congestion at a port, terminal or border.

HandlingInstruction.name: Handling instruction
HandlingInstruction.description: How goods or transport handling units are to be handled and stowed.

STACK2: Not more than two units on top of each other.
NOSTACK: Nothing may be stacked on the unit.
UPRIGHT: Keep the unit the right way up.
DECK: The carrier may stow the container on deck.

ShippingPriority.name: Shipping priority
ShippingPriority.description: The priority a consignment is given in loading and carriage.

STANDARD: No priority: the next departure with room.
PRIORITY: Loaded first, on the first departure with room.
EXPRESS: A dedicated or the fastest service.

TransportNotificationType.name: Transport notification type
TransportNotificationType.description: The kind of notice or report that a carrier or a ship gives.

PREARRIVAL: Notice before the means of transport arrives.
PREDEPARTURE: Notice before the means of transport leaves.

TransportReportType.name: Transport report type
TransportReportType.description: The kind of report a ship or a carrier makes.

PREARRIVAL: The report before entering a port.
NOON: The daily position report at sea.

PortCallPurpose.name: Port call purpose
PortCallPurpose.description: Why a ship calls at a port.

ServiceInformationPreference.name: Service information preference
ServiceInformationPreference.description: What a transport user wants to know first about a service.

ServiceOfferResponse.name: Service offer response
ServiceOfferResponse.description: A carrier's answer to a request for a transport service.

NOTOFFERED: The carrier does not offer the service.
ALTERNATIVE: The carrier offers another service instead.

DocumentStatusReason.name: Document status reason
DocumentStatusReason.description: Why a transport plan or request has the status it has.

UPDATE: The request or plan changes a plan already agreed.

FreightRateClass.name: Freight rate class
FreightRateClass.description: The class of a carrier's tariff a freight rate belongs to.

BOX: The rate is per container, not per weight or volume.
B: The basic class of the tariff, for goods without a special rate.
WM: The rate per tonne or per cubic metre, whichever gives more.

TariffClass.name: Tariff class
TariffClass.description: The class of a carrier's tariff a service is charged in.

B: The basic class of the tariff.

CARGO: The cargo a means of transport carries.

WaybillType.name: Waybill type
WaybillType.description: The kind of waybill by the legal regime of the carriage. The descriptions give the matching UN/EDIFACT 1001 code.

CMR: A consignment note under the Convention on the Contract for the International Carriage of Goods by Road (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 730).
CIM: A consignment note under the Uniform Rules concerning the Contract of International Carriage of Goods by Rail (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 720).
AWB: An air waybill under the Montreal Convention (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 740).
CMNI: A non-negotiable transport document under the Budapest Convention on the Contract for the Carriage of Goods by Inland Waterway (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 700, waybill; 711 is a negotiable bill of lading).
SEA: A non-negotiable transport document for carriage by sea (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 700).

VGM: The gross mass of a packed container, verified as the SOLAS Convention requires.
WEIGHBRIDGE: The weight of a vehicle and its load on a weighbridge.

CargoType.name: Cargo type
CargoType.description: The kind of cargo by the way it is carried. The descriptions give the matching UN/EDIFACT 7085 code where it has one.

GEN: Goods in packages, on pallets or in containers (UN/EDIFACT 7085: 12 General cargo).
BULK: Loose dry goods such as ore or grain, poured into the hold (UN/EDIFACT 7085 has no bulk code).
BREAKBULK: Large single pieces loaded one by one (UN/EDIFACT 7085: 10 Breakbulk).

PARTLOADED: Loaded with part of its capacity.

LESSOR: A leasing company owns the equipment.

EquipmentProviderType.name: Equipment provider type
EquipmentProviderType.description: Who provides transport equipment for a carriage.

FORWARDER: The freight forwarder provides the equipment.

SealIssuerType.name: Seal issuer type
SealIssuerType.description: Who issued a seal on transport equipment. The descriptions map to the DCSA eBL 3.0.3 seal source and to UN/EDIFACT 9303 (sealing party).

VETERINARY: DCSA VET; UN/EDIFACT 9303 AC Quarantine agency.
PHYTOSANITARY: No DCSA equivalent in eBL 3.0; UN/EDIFACT 9303 AC Quarantine agency.

SealStatus.name: Seal status
SealStatus.description: The condition of a seal. The descriptions map to UN/EDIFACT 4517 (seal condition).

APPLIED: The seal is in place and intact (UN/EDIFACT 4517: 1 In right condition).
REPLACED: A new seal replaced the original one.

LoadType.name: Load type
LoadType.description: Whether transport equipment carries one consignment or several.

FCL: The container holds one shipper's goods for one consignee.
LCL: The container holds the goods of several shippers or for several consignees.

TrackingDevice.name: Tracking device
TrackingDevice.description: The kind of device that tracks transport equipment.

GPS: A device that reports its position by satellite navigation.
RFID: A tag read at gates and terminals.
BLE: A beacon read by nearby receivers.

ISO6346.name: ISO 6346 container size and type code
ISO6346.reference: ISO 6346 (a paid ISO standard; the size and type codes as the standard publishes them)

22G1: 20 ft, 8 ft 6 in high, general purpose
22R1: 20 ft, 8 ft 6 in high, thermal, refrigerated
22U1: 20 ft, 8 ft 6 in high, open top
42G1: 40 ft, 8 ft 6 in high, general purpose
45G1: 40 ft, 9 ft 6 in high, general purpose
45R1: 40 ft, 9 ft 6 in high, thermal, refrigerated

UNCL8051.name: UN/EDIFACT 8051 Transport stage code qualifier
UNCL8051.reference: UNTDID D.22A, data element 8051 (unece.org, blocked for automated access)

10: Transport by which the goods are moved prior to their main carriage transport.
20: The primary stage in the movement of cargo from the point of origin to the intended destination.
30: Transport by which the goods are moved after the main-carriage transport.

UNCL7075.name: UN/EDIFACT 7075 Packaging level
UNCL7075.reference: UNTDID D.22A, data element 7075 (unece.org, blocked for automated access)

1: Level of packing, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the intermediate packaging level.
2: Level of packaging, if it exists, that is immediately subordinate to the outer packaging level.
3: Level of packing that is the outermost.

IMOISPS.name: IMO ISPS Code security level
IMOISPS.reference: International Ship and Port Facility Security Code, part A, section 2

1: The level for which minimum appropriate protective security measures shall be maintained at all times.
2: The level for which appropriate additional protective security measures shall be maintained for a period of time as a result of heightened risk.
3: The level for which further specific protective security measures shall be maintained for a limited period of time when a security incident is probable or imminent.

IMOINF.name: IMO INF Code ship class
IMOINF.version: INF Code (SOLAS chapter VII, part D)
IMOINF.reference: International Code for the Safe Carriage of Packaged Irradiated Nuclear Fuel, Plutonium and High-Level Radioactive Wastes on board Ships, 1.3

INF1: Certified to carry INF cargo with an aggregate activity less than 4,000 TBq (the Code writes INF.1).
INF2: Certified to carry irradiated nuclear fuel or high-level radioactive wastes with an aggregate activity less than 2 × 10^6 TBq.
INF3: Certified to carry irradiated nuclear fuel or high-level radioactive wastes and plutonium with no restriction of the maximum aggregate activity.

ITUAISNavStatus.name: ITU-R M.1371 AIS navigational status
ITUAISNavStatus.reference: Recommendation ITU-R M.1371, Annex 2, message 1, navigational status

ISO5218.name: ISO/IEC 5218 Representation of human sexes
ISO5218.reference: ISO/IEC 5218 (codes as the standard publishes them)

ShipPersonRole.name: Role on board
ShipPersonRole.description: The role of a person on board a ship.

CHIEFENG: The head of the engine department.
SSO: Responsible for the security of the ship (ISPS Code).
MEDICAL: The person in charge of medical care on board.
PASSENGER: A person on board who is not crew.

ShipWasteType.name: Ship waste type
ShipWasteType.description: Waste from ships by the annex of the MARPOL Convention that governs it.

OIL: Oily residues and bilge water (MARPOL Annex I).
NOXIOUS: Residues of noxious liquids carried in bulk (MARPOL Annex II).
GARBAGE: Food waste, plastics, cargo residues and other garbage (MARPOL Annex V).
SCRUBBER: Residues from exhaust gas cleaning (MARPOL Annex VI).

BallastExchangeMethod.name: Ballast water exchange method
BallastExchangeMethod.description: How ballast water was exchanged, following the guidelines of the Ballast Water Management Convention.

SEQ: The tank is emptied and refilled with open-sea water.
FLOW: Open-sea water is pumped through the tank, three times its volume.
DIL: Water is pumped in from the top and out from the bottom at the same rate.

WING: A tank at the side of the ship.
DOUBLEBOTTOM: A tank in the double bottom.
PEAK: A tank in the fore or after peak.
TOPSIDE: A tank under the deck at the side.

SanitaryMeasure.name: Sanitary measure
SanitaryMeasure.description: A sanitary measure taken on board, as the International Health Regulations name them.

EnergySource.name: Energy source
EnergySource.description: The source of energy a means of transport or a process uses.

MGO: A distillate marine fuel of low sulphur content.

FuelType.name: Fuel type
FuelType.description: The fuel a means of transport burns.

MGO: A distillate marine fuel of low sulphur content (ISO 8217 DMA).

TransitDirection.name: Transit direction
TransitDirection.description: Whether goods leave, enter or pass through a customs territory.

TRANSIT: The goods pass through the country.

RiskResponsibleParty.name: Party bearing the risk
RiskResponsibleParty.description: Who bears the risk of loss of or damage to the goods.

UNModelRegsUN.name: UN Model Regulations dangerous goods list (UN numbers)
UNModelRegsUN.version: Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, Model Regulations, 24th revised edition
UNModelRegsUN.reference: UN Model Regulations, chapter 3.2 Dangerous Goods List

3480: Lithium ion batteries (including lithium ion polymer batteries)
3481: Lithium ion batteries contained in equipment or packed with equipment
2911: Radioactive material, excepted package – instruments or articles
1203: Motor spirit or gasoline or petrol

UNModelRegsClass.name: UN Model Regulations hazard class and division
UNModelRegsClass.version: Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods, Model Regulations, 24th revised edition

4.3: Substances which in contact with water emit flammable gases

UNPackingGroup.name: Packing group
UNPackingGroup.description: The packing group of dangerous goods, following the UN Model Regulations (2.0.1.3), with a code for goods to which no packing group is assigned. The build checks that it agrees with the UN/EDIFACT 8339 packaging danger level: I with 1, II with 2, III with 3, NA with 4.

NA: The UN entry has no packing group, such as lithium batteries (UN 3480) or radioactive material.

codes.4: The UN entry has no packing group.

IMDGEmS.name: IMO IMDG Code emergency schedules (EmS)
IMDGEmS.reference: IMDG Code, Dangerous Goods List column 15, as the BAM DGG-Info database gives it for UN 3480, 2920 and 2911 (the IMDG Code is a paid IMO publication)

F-A,S-I: Fire schedule Alpha, spillage schedule India
General fire schedule; flammable solids. The IMDG Code writes F-A, S-I; the world's code leaves out the space.
F-E,S-C: Fire schedule Echo, spillage schedule Charlie
Non-water-reactive flammable liquids; flammable, corrosive liquids.
F-I,S-S: Fire schedule India, spillage schedule Sierra
F-A,S-A: Fire schedule Alpha, spillage schedule Alpha
F-E,S-E: Fire schedule Echo, spillage schedule Echo
Non-water-reactive flammable liquids; flammable liquids floating on water.

ERG2024.name: Emergency Response Guidebook 2024, guide numbers
ERG2024.agency: US DOT PHMSA, Transport Canada, SCT Mexico
ERG2024.reference: Emergency Response Guidebook 2024, orange pages, as NOAA CAMEO Chemicals gives them

147: Lithium Ion and Sodium Ion Batteries

ADRTunnel.name: ADR tunnel restriction code
ADRTunnel.agency: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe
ADRTunnel.reference: ADR 8.6.4 and the tunnel restriction codes of column 15 of Table A, 3.2.1 (the slash is ADR's own notation)

B: Passage forbidden through tunnels of category B, C, D and E.
B1000C: Above 1,000 kg net explosive mass: passage forbidden through B, C, D and E; below: through C, D and E.
B/D: Tank carriage: forbidden through B, C, D and E; other carriage: through D and E.
B/E: Tank carriage: forbidden through B, C, D and E; other carriage: through E.
C: Passage forbidden through tunnels of category C, D and E.
C/D: Tank carriage: forbidden through C, D and E; other carriage: through D and E.
C/E: Tank carriage: forbidden through C, D and E; other carriage: through E.
D: Passage forbidden through tunnels of category D and E.
D/E: Bulk or tank carriage: forbidden through D and E; other carriage: through E.
E: Passage forbidden through tunnels of category E.

MarinePollutant.name: Marine pollutant
MarinePollutant.description: Whether goods are a marine pollutant under the IMDG Code (2.10).

P: The goods are a marine pollutant and carry the mark.
N: The goods are not a marine pollutant.

HazardousGoodsType.name: Dangerous goods type
HazardousGoodsType.description: Whether dangerous goods are a substance or an article.

ARTICLE: An article containing dangerous goods, such as a battery or a detector.
SUBSTANCE: A substance, such as a liquid or a gas.

TransportEmergencyCard.name: Transport emergency card
TransportEmergencyCard.description: The Trade Accord's instructions in writing for the crew, one card per hazard class, following the class-based instructions in writing of ADR (5.4.3). The build checks that the card matches the class of the goods.

TEC4: Flammable solids and substances liable to spontaneous combustion or emitting flammable gases with water.
TEC9: Miscellaneous dangerous substances and articles, including lithium batteries.
TECGEN: The general instructions for all classes, carried with the class card.

TransportAuthorization.name: Transport authorization
TransportAuthorization.description: A restriction on the means of transport dangerous goods may travel by.

CAO: The goods may be carried on cargo aircraft only.
PCA: The goods may also be carried on passenger aircraft.
ROADONLY: The goods may be carried by road only.

PackingInstruction.name: Air packing instruction
PackingInstruction.description: The packing instruction dangerous goods are packed under for carriage by air, following the IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations.

PI965IA: Lithium ion batteries, packed alone, above the limits of section IB.
PI965IB: Lithium ion batteries, packed alone, within the limits of section IB.
PI966: Lithium ion batteries packed with equipment.
PI967: Lithium ion batteries contained in equipment.

InhalationToxicityZone.name: Inhalation toxicity zone
InhalationToxicityZone.description: The hazard zone of goods toxic by inhalation, modelled on the four zones of the US Hazardous Materials Regulations (49 CFR 173.116 and 173.133), with a code for goods that are not toxic by inhalation.

B: LC50 above 200 and up to 1,000 ppm.
C: LC50 above 1,000 and up to 3,000 ppm.
D: LC50 above 3,000 and up to 5,000 ppm.
NOTTOXIC: The goods are not toxic by inhalation.

CustomsProcedure.name: Customs procedure
CustomsProcedure.description: The customs procedures of the Trade Accord's common customs data model. A code is the requested procedure (two digits) followed by the previous procedure (two digits, 00 if there was none). The Accord is a free trade area, not a customs union: the procedures are common, the tariffs national. Requested and previous procedures: 10 release for free circulation, 20 temporary admission, 30 export, 35 re-export, 40 transit, 50 customs warehousing, 00 no previous procedure.

1000: Release for free circulation, no previous procedure
Goods imported and released for free circulation directly.
1020: Release for free circulation after temporary admission
Goods temporarily admitted that stay in the country.
1040: Release for free circulation after transit
Goods released at the office of destination of a transit.
1050: Release for free circulation from a customs warehouse
Goods taken out of a customs warehouse into free circulation.
2000: Goods brought in for a limited time and a stated purpose, such as a fair, under a guarantee or an ATA carnet.
3000: Goods in free circulation leaving the country.
3520: Goods temporarily admitted leaving the country again.
3550: Goods leaving a customs warehouse for abroad.
4000: Goods carried under customs control to an office of destination.
5000: Goods stored in a customs warehouse without duty paid.

CustomsStatus.name: Customs status
CustomsStatus.description: The customs status of goods in the territory that declares them.

FOREIGN: Goods not in free circulation in the declaring territory: from abroad and not released, or under a special procedure.
FREE: Goods in free circulation in the declaring territory.

CustomsDeclarationType.name: Customs declaration type
CustomsDeclarationType.description: The kind of a customs declaration in the Trade Accord's customs data model.

REEXPORT: Goods under a special procedure leaving the territory.
TRANSIT: Goods carried across the territory under customs control.
TEMPADMISSION: Goods brought in for a limited time.

CustomsDeclarationSubType.name: Customs declaration subtype
CustomsDeclarationSubType.description: The subtype of a customs declaration.

FREECIRC: An import declaration for release for free circulation.
EXTTRANSIT: Goods not in free circulation carried under customs control.
INTTRANSIT: Goods in free circulation carried through another territory.
SIMPLIFIED: A declaration with fewer data, completed later.
SUPPLEMENTARY: The declaration that completes a simplified one.

UNCL1225.name: UN/EDIFACT 1225 Message function
UNCL1225.reference: UNTDID D.22A, data element 1225, as the WCO Data Model uses it (unece.org, blocked for automated access)

1: Message cancelling a previous transmission for a given transaction.
4: Message containing items to be changed.
7: The message is a duplicate of a previously generated message.
9: Initial transmission related to a given transaction.
31: Indicates that the message is a copy of an original message that has been sent.

SALE: The goods are sold to a buyer abroad.
EXHIBITION: The goods are shown at an exhibition or fair and come back.
REPAIR: The goods are sent for repair and come back.
RETURN: The goods are returned to their supplier.
GIFT: The goods are given free of charge.

TEMPORARY: The goods come back, unchanged or after processing.

NatureOfTransaction.name: Nature of transaction
NatureOfTransaction.description: The kind of transaction behind a movement of goods, for customs and trade statistics. The descriptions name the matching code of the nature-of-transaction list of the UN International Merchandise Trade Statistics and the EU.

PURCHASE: Goods bought and sold (UN/EU nature of transaction 1).
PROCESSING: Goods sent for or returned after processing under contract (UN/EU 4 and 5).
LEASE: Goods leased under a financial lease (UN/EU 9).

CustomsLocationType.name: Customs location type
CustomsLocationType.description: The kind of a place where customs keeps or checks goods.

BONDEDSTORE: A warehouse licensed by customs to store goods without duty paid.
FREEZONE: An area treated as outside the customs territory.

PreferenceCriterion.name: Preference criterion
PreferenceCriterion.description: Why goods originate in a member state under the Trade Accord's rules of origin.

P: The goods are wholly obtained or produced in a member state.
S: The goods are processed enough in a member state to change their tariff heading.
V: At least the required share of the goods' value is added in the member states.

CertificateType.name: Certificate type
CertificateType.description: The kind of a certificate, licence or permit.

PERMIT: A permit an authority issues for an activity, such as the recovery of waste.
BONDEDSTORE: The customs licence to keep a bonded store.
COTTONCLASS: The classing of cotton by grade, staple and micronaire.
RECYCLED: The share of recycled material in a product.
TEST: The results of a test of a product.

GoodsCertificateType.name: Goods certificate type
GoodsCertificateType.description: The kind of certificate an authority issues for goods.

PHYTO: Plants or plant products are free of the pests the importing country names.
VETERINARY: Animals or animal products meet the importing country's health rules.

AttestationType.name: Attestation type
AttestationType.description: What an attestation line of a goods certificate attests.

PEST: The goods were checked for a pest.
ORIGIN: Where the goods were grown or produced.

GoodsProcessingType.name: Goods processing type
GoodsProcessingType.description: How goods were processed, for certificates and rules of origin.

GINNING: Seed cotton separated into lint and seed.
PROCESSING: Processing in general, as a criterion names it.

EndorserRole.name: Endorser role
EndorserRole.description: The role in which a party endorses a certificate or a carnet.

ISSUER: The body that issues the document.
CHAMBER: A chamber of commerce endorses the document.
GUARANTOR: The association that guarantees the duties of an ATA carnet.

CardAccountRole.name: Card account role
CardAccountRole.description: The role of a person or party on a card account.

HOLDER: The person the card is issued to.
ADDITIONAL: A second person with a card on the account.
ACCOUNTHOLDER: The holder of the account the card is linked to.

BaselAnnexIV.name: Basel Convention, Annex IV: disposal and recovery operations
BaselAnnexIV.reference: Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal, Annex IV

D1: Deposit into or onto land (e.g. landfill)
R1: Use principally as a fuel or other means to generate energy
R3: Recycling/reclamation of organic substances which are not used as solvents
R4: Recycling/reclamation of metals and metal compounds

WasteOperationCategory.name: Waste operation category
WasteOperationCategory.description: Whether waste goes to recovery or to disposal, the distinction of the Basel Convention (Annex IV, B and A).

RECOVERY: Recovery operations (Basel Convention Annex IV B, R1 to R13).
DISPOSAL: Disposal operations (Basel Convention Annex IV A, D1 to D15).

WasteNotificationType.name: Waste notification type
WasteNotificationType.description: Whether a notification of a transboundary movement of waste is for recovery or for disposal (Basel Convention, Annex V A).

GENERAL: Several shipments of the same waste over up to a year.

ProcurementProcedure.name: Procurement procedure
ProcurementProcedure.description: The kind of procedure by which a contracting authority awards a contract (eForms procurement-procedure-type).

OPEN: Any interested economic operator may tender (eForms open).
RESTRICTED: Only the candidates invited after a selection may tender (eForms restricted).
NEGOTIATED: The authority negotiates with selected candidates (eForms neg-w-call).
NEGNOCALL: Allowed only in the cases the rules list (eForms neg-wo-call).
COMPDIALOGUE: The authority develops the solution in a dialogue with selected candidates (eForms comp-dial).
INNOVATION: For the development and purchase of an innovative product or service (eForms innovation).
DESIGNCONTEST: A plan or design selected by a jury, with or without prizes (eForms notice type for design contests).

ContractNature.name: Contract nature
ContractNature.description: The main nature of a public contract (eForms contract-nature).

SUPPLIES: The purchase, lease or rental of products (eForms supplies).
COMBINED: A mix of the above (eForms combined).

StrategicProcurement.name: Strategic procurement
StrategicProcurement.description: An aim of public procurement beyond the purchase itself (eForms strategic-procurement).

GREEN: The procurement reduces the environmental impact of the purchase (eForms env-imp).
SOCIAL: The procurement pursues a social objective (eForms soc-obj).
INNOVATIVE: The procurement buys an innovative solution (eForms inn-pur).

ProcurementSubType.name: Procurement subtype
ProcurementSubType.description: How supplies are acquired, or the kind of service with them (eForms contract-nature subtypes of supplies).

HIREPURCHASE: The products are rented and bought in instalments.
INSTALL: The installation of the products bought.

QualityControl.name: Quality control
QualityControl.description: How the buyer checks the quality of what is delivered.

ContractingSystem.name: Contracting system
ContractingSystem.description: The system under which a contract is used (eForms framework-agreement and dps-usage).

FRAMEWORK: A framework agreement without reopening of competition (eForms fa-wo-rc).
FRAMEWORKRC: Framework agreement with reopening of competition
NONE: Neither a framework agreement nor a dynamic purchasing system (eForms none).

ContractingSystemType.name: Contracting system type
ContractingSystemType.description: The type of the contracting system a procedure sets up (eForms framework-agreement).

FRAMEWORK: A framework agreement without reopening of competition (eForms fa-wo-rc).
FRAMEWORKRC: Framework agreement with reopening of competition

LotSubmission.name: Lot submission
LotSubmission.description: For how many lots a tenderer may tender (eForms tenders may be submitted for).

ONEORMORE: Tenders may cover one or more lots.
ONE: Tenders may cover one lot only.

PAPER: On paper, by post or by hand.

Urgency.name: Urgency
Urgency.description: Whether a procedure runs with the normal time limits.

ACCELERATED: Shorter time limits for a justified urgency (eForms accelerated procedure).

ExpenseType.name: Expense type
ExpenseType.description: The kind of budget a procurement is paid from.

ProcessReason.name: Process reason
ProcessReason.description: Why the procedure takes the form it takes (eForms direct-award-justification for the exceptional cases).

STANDARD: The value is above the threshold for the procedure chosen, so the standard rules apply.
BELOWTHRESHOLD: The value is below the threshold.
URGENCY: Unforeseeable events leave no time for the normal procedure (eForms urgency).

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation reason
CancellationReason.description: Why a procedure was cancelled (eForms non-award-justification), also for the cancellation of a previous procedure.

NOTENDERS: No tenders, or only unsuitable ones, were received (eForms no-rece).
UNSUITABLE: All tenders were irregular or unacceptable (eForms all-rej).
BUDGET: The tenders exceeded the budget (eForms budget).
CHANGEDNEEDS: The authority no longer needs what it asked for.

AwardCriterionType.name: Award criterion type
AwardCriterionType.description: The kind of an award criterion (eForms award-criterion-type).

AwardingMethod.name: Awarding method
AwardingMethod.description: How the winning tender is chosen.

BESTVALUE: The tender with the best ratio of price and quality wins.
LOWESTPRICE: The cheapest tender that meets the requirements wins.
LOWESTCOST: The tender with the lowest life-cycle cost wins.

CalculationExpression.name: Calculation expression
CalculationExpression.description: How the points of an award criterion are calculated.

INVERSE: The lowest value gets full points, others in inverse proportion.
PROPORTIONAL: The highest value gets full points, others in proportion.
SCALE: Points from a scale of marks.

WeightingAlgorithm.name: Weighting algorithm
WeightingAlgorithm.description: How the points of the award criteria are combined.

WSUM: The points multiplied by their weights and added up.
ORDER: The criteria in order of importance, without weights.

EvaluationCriterionType.name: Evaluation criterion type
EvaluationCriterionType.description: What a selection criterion evaluates (ESPD-EDM selection criteria).

Expression.name: Expression
Expression.description: How a value is compared with a threshold in an evaluation criterion.

TenderEnvelope.name: Tender envelope
TenderEnvelope.description: How the parts of a tender are submitted.

COMBINED: One envelope with the technical and the financial part.
FINANCIAL: The financial envelope, opened after the technical evaluation.

COMBINED: A tender with both parts in one.
VARIANT: A variant to the solution asked.

TenderResult.name: Tender result
TenderResult.description: The outcome of a procedure for a lot (eForms winner-selection-status).

NOTAWARDED: The procedure was closed without a winner (eForms clos-nw).
OPEN: The winner is not yet chosen (eForms open-nw).

TENDER: That the tenderer keeps its tender open and signs if it wins.
PERFORMANCE: That the contractor performs the contract.
ADVANCE: That an advance payment is paid back if not earned.
WARRANTY: That defects found after delivery are remedied.

GuaranteeConstitution.name: Guarantee constitution
GuaranteeConstitution.description: How a financial guarantee is given.

FeeType.name: Fee type
FeeType.description: The kind of an additional fee in a procurement.

DOCUMENTS: For paper copies of the procurement documents.
PARTICIPATION: For taking part in the procedure.

NoticeType.name: Notice type
NoticeType.description: The kind of a public procurement notice (eForms notice-type).

BUSREG: Information on an economic operator from a business register.

EXTRACT: An extract from a register, asked for by a contracting authority.
FULL: The full record of the register.
CORRECTION: A correction of an earlier notice.

MultipleTenders.name: Multiple tenders
MultipleTenders.description: Whether a tenderer may submit more than one tender (eForms tenders: multiple tenders).

VariantConstraint.name: Variant constraint
VariantConstraint.description: Whether variants may be tendered (eForms variants).

SubcontractingConditions.name: Subcontracting conditions
SubcontractingConditions.description: Whether and how the contractor may subcontract (eForms subcontracting).

LIMITED: Subcontracting is allowed up to the share stated.

CriterionResponse.name: Criterion response
CriterionResponse.description: The answer to a requirement of a tendering criterion (ESPD-EDM).

NOTAPPLICABLE: The requirement does not apply to the tenderer.

CriterionPropertyType.name: Criterion property type
CriterionPropertyType.description: The kind of element of a tendering criterion (ESPD-EDM criterion-element-type).

QUESTION: Question
A question the tenderer answers (ESPD QUESTION).
REQUIREMENT: A requirement set by the authority (ESPD REQUIREMENT).
CAPTION: Caption
A heading (ESPD CAPTION).

TenderEventType.name: Tender event type
TenderEventType.description: An event of a tendering procedure.

ResponseDataType.name: Response data type
ResponseDataType.description: The kind of value an answer to a criterion takes (ESPD-EDM response-data-type).

PropertyGroupType.name: Property group type
PropertyGroupType.description: When a group of properties of a criterion is answered (ESPD-EDM property-group-type).

ONTRUE: Answered when the criterion applies (ESPD ONTRUE).
ONFALSE: Answered when the criterion does not apply (ESPD ONFALSE).

FulfilmentIndicator.name: Fulfilment indicator
FulfilmentIndicator.description: How many properties of a criterion must be fulfilled.

CriterionType.name: Criterion type
CriterionType.description: The kind of a tendering criterion (ESPD-EDM criterion types).

EXCLUSION: A ground for excluding a tenderer.
ECONOMIC: A selection criterion on the tenderer's finances.
TECHNICAL: A selection criterion on the tenderer's experience and staff.
SUITABILITY: A selection criterion on the pursuit of the professional activity.

EvaluationMethod.name: Evaluation method
EvaluationMethod.description: How a criterion is evaluated (ESPD-EDM evaluation method).

PASSFAIL: The criterion is met or not.
WEIGHTED: The criterion is scored and weighted.

EvidenceType.name: Evidence type
EvidenceType.description: The kind of evidence supplied for a criterion.

REFERENCE: A reference letter from a customer.

ConfidentialityLevel.name: Confidentiality level
ConfidentialityLevel.description: Who may see a piece of evidence or an answer.

CONFIDENTIAL: Only the contracting authority may see it.
RESTRICTED: Only the evaluators may see it.

CopyQuality.name: Copy quality
CopyQuality.description: What kind of copy of a document is accepted.

ExpectedResponse.name: Expected response
ExpectedResponse.description: The answer a criterion expects as a code.

REGISTERED: Entered in the register the criterion names.
CERTIFIED: Holding the certificate the criterion names.

TranslationType.name: Translation type
TranslationType.description: What translation a document in another language needs.

NONE: The document is accepted in its own language.
CERTIFIED: A translation certified by a sworn translator.

WeightingType.name: Weighting type
WeightingType.description: Whether the criteria of a qualification are weighted.

QualificationApplicationType.name: Qualification application type
QualificationApplicationType.description: Under which rules a qualification application is made (ESPD-EDM qualification-application-type).

DeclarationType.name: Declaration type
DeclarationType.description: The kind of a declaration a tenderer makes.

INTEGRITY: The tenderer declares it has not colluded or bribed.
CONFLICT: The tenderer declares any conflict of interest.

ContractingPartyType.name: Contracting party type
ContractingPartyType.description: The legal type of a contracting authority (eForms buyer-legal-type).

AuthorityActivity.name: Authority activity
AuthorityActivity.description: The main activity of a contracting authority (eForms main-activity).

COMMUNITY: Including public works and parks (eForms hc-am).

RepresentationType.name: Representation type
RepresentationType.description: On whose behalf a contracting authority buys.

Curricula.name: Curricula
Curricula.description: The professional qualifications a contract asks of the staff that performs it. Shared by RequiredCurriculaCode.

SAFETY: Safety training for work on public sites.

UNITPRICE: The unit prices of the price schedule.
TOTALPRICE: The total price of the tender.

PERRELEASE: After each release under a framework contract.
ONCOMPLETION: Once, when the contract is completed.

AnnotationSubject.name: Annotation subject
AnnotationSubject.description: What a note in a procurement document is about.

ExecutionRequirement.name: Execution requirement
ExecutionRequirement.description: A requirement on how a contract is performed (eForms execution-requirement).

TendererRequirementType.name: Tenderer requirement type
TendererRequirementType.description: A requirement on the tenderer itself.

ENVIRONMENTAL: The tenderer manages its environmental impact.
SHELTERED: The contract is reserved for sheltered workshops (eForms reserved-procurement).

BusinessPartyGroupType.name: Business party group type
BusinessPartyGroupType.description: Why parties are grouped in a business register's information.

SAMEACTIVITY: The parties are registered for the same activity.
SAMEGROUP: The parties belong to one group.

BusinessCapabilityType.name: Business capability type
BusinessCapabilityType.description: A capability of a business, as a register records it.

EconomicOperatorRole.name: Economic operator role
EconomicOperatorRole.description: The role of an economic operator in a tender (ESPD-EDM economic-operator-role).

MEMBER: Another member of the group (ESPD GROUP_MEMBER).
SUBCONTRACTOR: A subcontractor whose capacities are relied on (ESPD OERON).

TendererRole.name: Tenderer role
TendererRole.description: The role of a qualifying party in a tender.

SecurityClearance.name: Security clearance
SecurityClearance.description: The security clearance the staff of a contractor need.

BASIC: A basic check of the staff.

OperationType.name: Operation type
OperationType.description: The kind of operation a party carries out.

WorkPhase.name: Work phase
WorkPhase.description: A phase of the work under a contract.

PrizeRank.name: Prize rank
PrizeRank.description: The rank of a prize in a design contest.

CatalogueAction.name: Catalogue action
CatalogueAction.description: Whether a catalogue is new, replaces an earlier one or updates it.

UPDATE: The catalogue changes the earlier one.

CatalogueLineAction.name: Catalogue line action
CatalogueLineAction.description: What the receiver does with a catalogue line to synchronize its copy, as UBL recommends (add, update, delete).

ConditionsAction.name: Conditions action
ConditionsAction.description: What a party does with conditions of sale or payment.

ItemLifeCycleStatus.name: Item life cycle status

ItemPartPosition.description: The part of an item an attribute is on.

ItemPropertyName.description: The name of an item property as a code, for items and meters.

ACC: The accuracy class of a meter.

PropertyImportance.name: Property importance
PropertyImportance.description: How much a property matters in describing an item.

PriceType.name: Price type
PriceType.description: The kind of a price, as both buyer and seller understand it.

RRP: The price the maker recommends for consumers.

CON: The price agreed in a contract, such as a framework contract.
PRO: A price for a limited time.

PackLevel.description: The level of packing a price or quantity refers to.

PromotionalEventType.description: The kind of a promotional event.

PackingLabelingType.name: Packing and labelling type
PackingLabelingType.description: How trade items are packed or labelled for a promotion.

ORDER: The orders the buyer expects to place.

ForecastType.description: Which part of the demand a forecast covers.

ComparisonData.name: Comparison data
ComparisonData.description: What data a forecast exception is compared with.

DataSource.description: Which trading partner the data come from. Shared by DataSourceCode and ComparisonDataSourceCode (qualified variants).

SERVICELEVEL: Share of orders delivered in full and on time.

SupplyChainActivity.name: Supply chain activity
SupplyChainActivity.description: The activity data are reported for.

ExceptionResolution.name: Exception resolution
ExceptionResolution.description: How an exception criterion says an exception is resolved.

Resolution.name: Resolution
Resolution.description: How a reported exception is resolved.

REVIEW: The partners review the exception together.

ExceptionStatus.name: Exception status
ExceptionStatus.description: Where an exception criterion or a reported exception stands.

CollaborationPriority.name: Collaboration priority
CollaborationPriority.description: The priority of an exception between trading partners.

ThresholdValueComparison.name: Threshold value comparison
ThresholdValueComparison.description: How a value is compared with the threshold of an exception criterion.

ForecastAdjustmentReason.name: Forecast adjustment reason

RevisionStatus.name: Revision status
RevisionStatus.description: Whether a forecast is new or revised.

BLOCKED: Held back, for instance for inspection.

InspectionMethod.description: How goods were inspected on receipt.

RejectAction.name: Reject action
RejectAction.description: What the buyer asks for goods it refused.

ShortageAction.name: Shortage action
ShortageAction.description: What the buyer asks for goods short-delivered.

QuantityDiscrepancy.name: Quantity discrepancy
QuantityDiscrepancy.description: Why the quantity received differs from the quantity despatched.

TimingComplaint.name: Timing complaint
TimingComplaint.description: A complaint about the time of a delivery.

DespatchAdviceType.name: Despatch advice type
DespatchAdviceType.description: The kind of a despatch, as a subtype of the despatch advice (UN/EDIFACT 1001: 351 Despatch advice).

DocumentCopyType.description: Whether a distributed document is an original or a copy.

DAMAGEREPORT: A report of damage to goods.

UBLDocumentType.description: The document types of UBL 2.5 by their names, for a generic reference to a UBL document whose type the reference element does not say.

CO2E: All greenhouse gases, weighted by their global warming potential.

LifecycleStage.name: Life cycle stage
LifecycleStage.description: A stage of a product's life, as the UBL definition names them; each description gives the matching modules of EN 15804.

SOURCING: Raw material supply and its transport (EN 15804 modules A1 and A2).
DISTRIBUTION: Transport to the user and installation (EN 15804 modules A4 and A5).
USAGE: Use, maintenance, repair and replacement (EN 15804 modules B1 to B7).
ENDOFLIFE: Deconstruction, transport, waste processing and disposal (EN 15804 modules C1 to C4).
RECOVERY: Reuse, recovery and recycling beyond the product's life (EN 15804 module D).

EmissionBoundary.name: Emission boundary
EmissionBoundary.description: How much of a product's life an emission figure includes.

CRADLETOGATE: From the raw materials to the product leaving the factory (EN 15804 A1 to A3).
CRADLETOGRAVE: The whole life, to disposal (EN 15804 A to C).
CRADLETOCRADLE: The whole life, with recovery (EN 15804 A to D).

CircularityType.name: Circularity type
CircularityType.description: The circular strategy behind an item.

MaintenanceFrequency.name: Maintenance frequency
MaintenanceFrequency.description: How often an item needs maintenance.

MaterialResource.name: Material resource
MaterialResource.description: A material an item is made of.

ScoringSystem.name: Scoring system
ScoringSystem.description: The scale of a repairability score.

REPAIR10: A score from 0 (cannot be repaired) to 10 (every part can be replaced).

WasteType.name: Waste type
WasteType.description: The kind of waste an item leaves.

TreatmentPathway.name: Treatment pathway
TreatmentPathway.description: What happens to an item after use.

EndOfLifeProcessing.name: End-of-life processing
EndOfLifeProcessing.description: How a used item is processed.

EnvironmentalImpactLevel.name: Environmental impact level
EnvironmentalImpactLevel.description: The environmental impact of an end-of-life option.

Category.name: Certified product category
Category.description: The category of goods a certificate covers. Shared by ApplicableCategoryCode (a qualified variant).

POSTAL: Where post is delivered, such as a post box.

CompanyLiquidationStatus.name: Company liquidation status
CompanyLiquidationStatus.description: Whether a company is in liquidation, as its register shows.

CorporateRegistrationType.name: Corporate registration type
CorporateRegistrationType.description: The kind of a register of organisations.

AddressFormat.name: Address format
AddressFormat.description: The address formats of the three countries: one code per country, its layout as the description (world/countries.json, address).

XB:CountrySubentity.description: The states and the federal territory of Bayvarra, in the structure of ISO 3166-2 (country code, hyphen, subdivision code) but not ISO 3166-2 itself.

XB-CO: A state, on the coast around Lumeport.
XB-NT: A federal territory on the north coast, with its own rate of the state sales tax.

XU:CompanyLegalForm.name: Company legal form
XU:CompanyLegalForm.description: The legal forms of companies in Urvania.

SUA: Società urvaniana per azioni (public limited company)
SRU: Società a responsabilità urvaniana (private limited company)

XB:CompanyLegalForm.description: The legal forms of companies in Bayvarra.

CORP: Abbreviated Corp in a company's name.
LTD: Abbreviated Ltd in a company's name.

XL:CompanyLegalForm.name: Company legal form
XL:CompanyLegalForm.description: The legal forms of companies in Lisavu.

LTD: Abbreviated Ltd in a company's name.

EntitySize.name: Entity size
EntitySize.description: The Trade Accord's size classes of enterprises, in the style of the EU definition of SMEs: an enterprise is in the smallest class whose limits it keeps, both for its headcount (annual work units) and its yearly turnover. The turnover limits are given in all three currencies, in their minor units, at the world's reference rates (1 lume = 100 ferra = 0.4 coral).

MICRO: Fewer than 10 persons and a turnover of at most 2,000,000.00 XBL, 200,000,000 XUF or 800,000.000 XLC.
SMALL: Fewer than 50 persons and a turnover of at most 10,000,000.00 XBL, 1,000,000,000 XUF or 4,000,000.000 XLC.
MEDIUM: Fewer than 250 persons and a turnover of at most 50,000,000.00 XBL, 5,000,000,000 XUF or 20,000,000.000 XLC.
LARGE: 250 persons or more, or a turnover above the limits of a medium-sized enterprise.

InsuranceCover.description: The cover of a cargo insurance, modelled on the Institute Cargo Clauses.

ALLRISKS: All risks of loss or damage, with the usual exclusions (Institute Cargo Clauses A).
NAMEDPERILS: Fire, stranding, collision and the other perils named (Institute Cargo Clauses B).
MINIMUM: Major casualties only (Institute Cargo Clauses C).

VOLUME: More or less than the contract foresaw.

DimensionAttribute.name: Dimension attribute
DimensionAttribute.description: Which dimension of a thing a measure gives: for Dimension, MeasurementDimension and RangeDimension. Each code names the UN/EDIFACT 6313 measured attribute it corresponds to.

LENGTH: The longest horizontal dimension. UN/EDIFACT 6313: LN.
WIDTH: The horizontal dimension across the length. UN/EDIFACT 6313: WD.
DEPTH: The dimension from front to back. UN/EDIFACT 6313: DP.
THICKNESS: The smallest dimension of a sheet, board or film. UN/EDIFACT 6313: TH.
DIAMETER: The diameter of a round thing. UN/EDIFACT 6313: DI.
SEATHEIGHT: The height of a seat above the floor. UN/EDIFACT 6313: HT.
BENCHLENGTH: The length of the seat of a bench. UN/EDIFACT 6313: LN.
LOADINGLENGTH: The length of the loading floor of a vehicle. UN/EDIFACT 6313: LN.
SLOTLENGTH: The length of the slot a thing occupies on a carrier, such as a container on a wagon. UN/EDIFACT 6313: LN.

TemperatureAttribute.name: Temperature attribute
TemperatureAttribute.description: What a temperature is the temperature of, or what it is for: for every Temperature element.

STORAGE: The temperature the goods are to be stored at.
TRANSPORT: The temperature in the cargo space during transport.
PRODUCT: The temperature of the goods themselves.
AMBIENT: The temperature of the space around the goods, such as a hall.
FLASHPOINT: The lowest temperature at which the vapour of a liquid ignites.
EMERGENCY: The temperature above which emergency procedures apply.
CONTROL: The highest temperature at which a substance can be transported safely.
WATER: The temperature of water, such as ballast water.

OtherAttribute.name: Attribute
OtherAttribute.description: Other attributes measured or described: space, capacity, colour and conditions.

COLOUR: The colour of an item or of a part of it.
FLOORSPACE: The floor area a thing takes.
PALLETPLACES: The number of pallet places a thing takes.
TEU: A capacity in twenty-foot equivalent units.
